source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original 1647 first edition Wellcome b30338724
scope_warning: Historic mutual astrology between TWO independent charts; conflict, romantic affection, alleged criminal intent and loyalty never verified in real pairs.

groups.topic: CLI pair of actual nativities, temperament and first/Ascendant-house comparison

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLI Whether there may be Concord or Unity betwixt two
claims.historical_meaning_only: A separately printed relational comparison chapter begins after divider original PDF671.
The asserted method explicitly requires TWO independently calculated natal charts.
Agreement versus disagreement of the charts is the author's putative relationship indicator.
Similar temperament and manners are claimed to indicate mutual good will.
Contrary temperament/manners are claimed to indicate conflict, a different outcome.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ascendant planets govern Temperament Manners Wits
claims.historical_meaning_only: Ascendant and occupants of each person's chart are linked to period personality categories.
Both Ascendant signs must be compared, not just one person's birth chart.
Ascendant occupants are a separate comparison layer.
Each Ascendant ruler is another compulsory input.
Sharing one ascending sign is a source favorable pairing case.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: whether they receive one and self same Planet
claims.historical_meaning_only: Shared planet ruling both rising signs is considered a possible source of affinity.
Mutual reception by dignity is another asserted favorable relation.
Benefic aspects between chart rulers are another conditional case.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: one and self same planet in either Horoscope
claims.historical_meaning_only: Same ruling/occupying ascendant planet is alleged to indicate similar manners.
The author connects matched ascendant planet with affinity and shared temperament.
The author cites likeness as rationale for attachment, not proof of attraction.
When two Ascendant planets differ, a different comparison is required.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: see then if they be friends or enemies
claims.historical_meaning_only: The natural friendships/enmities of planetary pair are invoked for different planets.
A planetary friendship is alleged to signify affection.
Planetary enmity allegedly predicts sustained antagonism, not an observed relationship.

groups.topic: Planetary natural friendship and enmity lists with directional asymmetry

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Friends of Saturn are Jupiter Sun Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: A printed table assigns a small set of Saturn's friend planets.
Saturn has another source list of planets called enemies.
Saturn's enmity against Venus is described as greater than toward Mars.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn parent sadnesse Venus mother mirth
claims.historical_meaning_only: The source supplies humoral psychology as a rationale for opposite planets.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter hath onely Mars for Enemy
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly identifies Mars as Jupiter's only natural enemy.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars hath onely Venus for Friend
claims.historical_meaning_only: Mars is claimed to regard Venus as its sole friend.
The author says Venus does not return Mars's affection; planetary friendship can be ASYMMETRIC.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars hot dry Venus cold moist
claims.historical_meaning_only: A humoral rationale is assigned to their divergence.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: diminisheth evil influence by good words
claims.historical_meaning_only: Venus is said to soften Mars through gentleness, not measured counseling efficacy.
A broad hostility claim is transmitted without independent natal performance.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun onely Jupiter and Venus Friends
claims.historical_meaning_only: The Sun is assigned two friend planets and all others supposedly enemies.
Venus regards Saturn as unique enemy under the source's description.
Mercury supposedly regards three planets as friends.
Moon also supposedly regards three as natural friends.
The northern lunar node receives a source natural friendship list.
South node-related planet sets are shown in a condensed glyph line, uncertain exact scope.

groups.topic: Four source modes of Ascendant-ruler unity and no-match conditional

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Observe Lord ascendant four manner ways
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly enumerates four routes alleged to produce mutual unity.
Both Ascendant rulers identical is first asserted unity route.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Secondly received by House or Exaltation
claims.historical_meaning_only: Reception by domicile/exaltation is second route, distinct from shared ruler.
Actual conjunction of two Ascendant lords across charts is third source route.
An aspect of sextile between Ascendant lords is a fourth source route.
Trine is an alternative within the fourth route.
Lack of any four modes triggers negative source inference.
Failure of the four modes supposedly predicts reduced duration, not necessarily zero initial affection.

groups.topic: Swapped luminaries/benefics and mixed planetary placements between two charts

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: places of Fortunes or Lights commutated
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author considers planets in each other's corresponding natal positions.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: one hath Venus where other Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: One explicit beneficial position exchange is Venus versus Moon.
The author alleges firm friendship from certain source swaps.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun or Moon or Mercury in each other's places
claims.historical_meaning_only: Other paired swaps of lights/Mercury are given different lower strength.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: good will stands not so firm
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly weakens the strength of some supposed good-will cases.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Jupiter Venus Mars each others places
claims.historical_meaning_only: A mixed group of Saturn/Jupiter/Venus/Mars occupation interchange allegedly affects cooperation.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: dissention mixed with kind of friendship
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author permits mixtures of affection and quarrelling, rather than strict binary.
This specific interchange is assigned a supposedly selfish union.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: join in love merely for covetousness
claims.historical_meaning_only: An unobserved motive is ascribed to Jupiter/Saturn interchange.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars and Venus each others place
claims.historical_meaning_only: Another planetary position-swap is given pejorative meaning.
The source alleges immoral collaboration, not any actual couple's intentions.

groups.topic: Malefic opposition, rival economic roles and unreliable common bad acts

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun or Mars opposition Mercury or Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author suggests a cross-chart adverse opposition relevant to harm; original glyphs not all unequivocal.
The outcome allegedly includes injury/conflict, unsupported personal-safety forecast.
A malefic called more dominant supposedly determines source harm.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn and Mars opposite each others Geniture
claims.historical_meaning_only: Saturn and Mars across the two charts provide a source high-conflict case.
A categorical enduring hostility allegation is made without real relationship data.
Other opposing malefic placements create an economic-rivalry source case.
The author ascribes competition for money to opposing malefic contacts.
Professions of competitors are named as broad historical examples.
When malefics 'agree', source outcome switches from rivalry to negative alliance.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Friends in wickedness or ill actions
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges shared wrongdoing under favorable malefic similarity.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: yet not very faithful to another
claims.historical_meaning_only: Even such supposed alliances are called unreliable, a distinct outcome.

groups.topic: Cross-chart Sun/Jupiter/Venus/Moon motives and strongest common-sign cases

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in place any Planet in other's Nativity
claims.historical_meaning_only: Solar location in another person's planetary place is a cross-chart condition.
Under this source exchange, honest/glorious motives are claimed, not observed.
A different planet swap is attributed practical benefit or utility.
Venus swap is ascribed pleasurable attachment.
Moon's supposed motive is modified by the nature of its placement, ambiguous.
The author introduces an alleged strongest class of pairwise friendship.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun of one in same Signe another Nativity
claims.historical_meaning_only: Sun sign correspondence across natal charts is one highest-tier possibility.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon of one in same Signe another
claims.historical_meaning_only: Moon sign correspondence is separately eligible.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Part Fortune one same Signe another
claims.historical_meaning_only: Part of Fortune may be another qualified candidate; original symbol check needed.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Asc of one same Signe another Nativity
claims.historical_meaning_only: Same-sign natal Ascendant ruler correspondence also enters strongest-tier case.
A categorical source favorable relationship evaluation, not human-validated.

groups.topic: Sincerity and asymmetrical favor according to both ascendant lords, negative eighth sixth twelfth correspondence

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Whether of the Friends is more sincere
claims.historical_meaning_only: An internal separate question asks which of two people feels more affection.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: he Loves most whose Lord Asc benevolent
claims.historical_meaning_only: One asserted comparison ranks affection by benefic quality of Ascendant ruler.
A beneficial Ascendant occupant is an alternative source condition.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Asc applies other's by sinister sextile
claims.historical_meaning_only: Application by a sinister sextile is another claimed favorable direction of affection.
Sinister trine is alternative favorable cross-chart application.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: he hates most Lord asc more malignant
claims.historical_meaning_only: A malefic Ascendant ruler is alleged to signify one person's dislike.
Malefic Ascendant occupant is another alleged hostile branch.
The source gives a categorical excluded-house arrangement.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Asc of one Sign twelfth of other
claims.historical_meaning_only: One person's Ascendant sign in other's twelfth-house sign is alleged to prevent harmony.
The other sixth-house sign is a second negative source case.
The other eighth-house sign is a third negative source case.
The author alleges categorical discord under the three house comparisons, without genuine dyad tests.
